observations: No CAPTCHAs or blocks encountered during this 5-request test
Amazon variant ASINs (B08JCM95X6) redirect to parent ASIN (B0D8123MXV) with ?th=1 param
The CSS selector '.a-price .a-offscreen' worked reliably for all 5 pages
Playwright MCP returns the full page snapshot (~120-145KB) with every evaluate call — this is extremely token-heavy
Each navigate+evaluate pair consumes ~260KB of raw output (saved to disk, not loaded into context)
2-second delay between requests was sufficient — no rate limiting observed
